# uv stubs backend scope experiment

This controlled carrier evaluates a scoped correction to the public stub-package initializer candidate.

The exact focused gate applies a one-file source transformation to the public candidate, compiles it, runs the native init controls, and builds application and library projects across eight build backends.

A successful focused run establishes only the tested backend boundary. Repository-wide formatting failures on unchanged historical documentation are recorded separately from the source candidate.

No canonical-upstream interaction is authorized or performed.
